body:
## Context

Binding design: docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md sections "Capture", "Continue", "Supervised-only auto-consume" and contract items 18-23 (added by the prerequisite spec ticket). Today @adlc/context-handoff exposes write/resume/bypass/repair/unlock (packages/context-handoff/bin/handoff.mjs); the deny marker + final + resume-auth + lock primitives all exist (lib/deny-marker.mjs, final.mjs, resume-auth.mjs, lock.mjs, deny-persist.mjs, deny-lifecycle.mjs, atomic-json.mjs, cli-helpers.mjs). This ticket adds the capture store and the one-shot `continue` orchestrator that composes them. No harness wiring here (next slice).

## Build

1. lib/paths.mjs: add `contentPath(root, sessionId)` -> `.adlc/handoffs/content/<session_id>.md` (assertSafeSessionId like siblings).
2. New lib/capture.mjs: writeCapture(root, sessionId, body) atomic; readCapture; `hashCaptureBody(body)` = sha256 over the canonicalized body (normalize line endings to \n; trim trailing whitespace per line — document the canonicalization in the module). Size-cap the stored body (64 KiB, truncate with an explicit truncation marker line — never silently).
3. New lib/brief.mjs: pure composer `composeBrief({ ticketId, ticketTitle, evidenceTail, gitBranch, gitStatus, flailSignals, modelNarrative })` -> markdown string with stable section headers (Ticket / State / Evidence / Model handoff). No child_process inside — callers gather inputs.
4. New lib/transcript-extract.mjs: `extractFinalAssistantMessage(jsonlText)` for Claude Code transcripts: parse JSONL lines fail-soft (skip malformed), take the trailing run of `type=="assistant"` lines sharing the final requestId, join their message.content[] text blocks with \n. Return null when nothing extractable. Cap at 32 KiB.
5. bin/handoff.mjs: new `continue` subcommand per spec: dry-run default; --write requires key (requireKeyOrExit) and holds the DENIER session lock (lockOrExit); steps: read deny marker (must be open; consumed/missing -> exit 2 degrade), resolve ticket (flag -> .adlc/current-ticket.json -> env-if-equal; null -> exit 2 degrade printing the exact `adlc handoff repair` one-liner), build capture (deterministic brief + optional --capture-from transcript extraction), writeCapture, write final bound to hashCaptureBody, rebind marker (reuse the runWrite rebind logic — refactor shared helpers out of runWrite rather than duplicating), mint successor id (--session or crypto.randomUUID), consume via the runResume flow for that successor, record evidence gate `context-handoff-continue` with { deny_session_id, successor_session_id, content_hash }, rollback all file mutations of this run when the evidence append fails (same posture as runWrite/runResume), emit payload JSON { successor_session_id, ticket_id, content_path, content_hash, bootstrap_prompt } where bootstrap_prompt = "Continuation of session <old> under ticket <id>. A context-rot handoff was captured; read it, verify against repo state, and continue the work.\n\n<capture body>".
6. lib/adapter.mjs (and the package-side HANDOFF_MUTATING_SUBCOMMANDS set consumed by harness copies): add 'continue'; extend isProtectedHandoffPath to cover `.adlc/handoffs/content` and `.adlc/handoffs/content/**`.
7. Tests — name files so the dependent claude-code ticket can freeze them by glob `continue-*.test.mjs` / `capture-*.test.mjs`: contract 18 (happy path: open bound deny + fixture transcript -> payload, marker consumed for minted successor only), 19 (unbound -> exit 2, marker still open, no resume-auth), 20 (evidence-append failure injected -> rollback: deny open, no resume-auth, no capture leftovers), 21 covered as unit on isProtectedHandoffPath for content paths, 22 (tamper capture file after continue -> resume-auth verify fails / readResumeAuth unverified), 23 (isHandoffMutatingShell matches `adlc handoff continue`). Follow existing cli-test/ fixture patterns for the CLI-level tests.

## Constraints

- Do not modify existing tests or thresholds; import lib/thresholds.mjs (adapter-test/no-adapter-threshold-literals.test.mjs enforces).
- Rails freeze the spec mirrors — implement the spec, never edit it here.
- Immutability/file-size house rules; small focused modules.

## Acceptance criteria

- All new + existing package tests green. verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/*.test.mjs` and `node --test packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/*.test.mjs` and `node --test packages/context-handoff/cli-test/*.test.mjs` all exit 0.
- 'continue' in the mutating-subcommand deny set. verify: `grep -n "'continue'" packages/context-handoff/lib/*.mjs` shows the set membership.
- Content paths protected. verify: adapter unit test for `.adlc/handoffs/content/x.md` returns true.
- Payload contract stable. verify: continue happy-path test asserts exact payload keys.

## Rails note (union semantics)

Rails are enforced as a union across all non-completed tickets, so this ticket declares none at authoring time (they would freeze the spec against the prerequisite spec-amendment ticket's own edit). AT BUILD START of this ticket (prerequisite completed:true), update this ticket (audited store write) to declare rails: ["docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md", ".adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md"] so the build implements the spec rather than editing it.
title: Build capture store + `adlc handoff continue` orchestrator in @adlc/context-handoff
